Score 100, rank 1, bus_lane_infrastructure, estimate +1.069 with all gates passing. The magnitude (a full standardized unit) on a short Randall's Island route is implausible as a bus-lane effect and suggests window contamination or treatment-dating error the gates did not catch. Panel is not complete enough to grade as a methodology-review candidate despite the gate passes.

Score 98, rank 2, bus_lane_infrastructure, estimate -0.937 with all gates passing. B39 is a Williamsburg Bridge shuttle with a history of service suspension/restoration; a near-unit negative swing more plausibly reflects service-pattern changes than the dated intervention. Treatment dating needs verification before this panel is review-grade.
